instructions:
## Objective

Recover numerical traces from photographed or scanned 12-lead ECG pages.

## Work to perform

Use paired training images and signals across nine imaging conditions. Reconstruct ten seconds for lead II and the visible 2.5-second segment for other leads at each record’s sampling rate. Generate predictions for every test record.

## Deliverable

Prediction file containing reconstructed samples for all leads.

## Evaluation

Aligned signal-to-noise ratio in dB on hidden records, with bounded temporal shifts and offset alignment before aggregation.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
